svg.title: Southern East Madagascar: offshore coastal reference curve
svg.desc: Eastern/southeastern Madagascar offshore coastal reference curve from an editorial20S gate to45.3E Cape approach. Exact gates and projected coast offsets are OSW conventions; not observed current endpoints, a velocity axis or downstream continuation. All27 geographic conventions clear both land masks; no measured current axis or width.
svg.text: Southern East Madagascar: coastal reference curve
Nominal: 25 km projected coast offset. This parameter is not current width.
Published branch extent: approximately 650 km, a separate source report.
Undated geographic guide; no measured axis, physical envelope or annual range.
Dashed: nominal geographic curve. Pale: all 27 declared conventions.
Exported curves clear both masks; full contours clear finer land. Axis review remains open.
Source geography: Nauw et al. (2008), doi:10.1029/2007JC004639, Introduction2/6.
Made with Natural Earth land 1:10 million v5.1.1. Map scale is not 10-metre accuracy.
Equirectangular map. Geographic construction only; not an observed current axis.
